title: Collection v1
description: A dated map collection: units with nullable point locations, dated presence, optional metric series or coded state values, optional person tenures, per-unit provenance, and a collection passport. One contract, two engine renderers (interval and stages); the series renderer remains standalone (Anglican prototype) until ruled. Collections are their own data source on a page: never merged with census products or with each other.

label.description: Public label of the collection as it appears in the data-source control and legend.

unit_kind.description: Default kind for every unit (e.g. mission_station, parish, culture); a unit may override.

construct.description: One-line measurement-regime statement rendered on the legend (measurement-diversity principle): what kind of record this collection renders, e.g. 'documented mission stations from atlas georeferences, never counts'.

credit.description: Display credit rendered in the passport and popup.

person_names_public.description: Whether tenure person names may enter the DOM. Historical deceased persons may be named per JB ruling 2026-08-29; a consent-gated collection declares false and ships person_ref only.

currency_schedule.description: Optional currency rule for monetary series (Anglican offerings precedent): the interface reads this, never infers it.

extensions.description: Builder-specific extras (data-manifest.v2 precedent); never read by the runtime.

kind.description: interval: units carry start_year/end_year filtered against calendar stops. series: units carry per-metric year series (standalone renderer only, for now). stages: units carry coded values per ordinal stage (Pulotu precedent).

stops.description: Calendar axes list years (integers); ordinal axes list {id, label} stages. The time control rebuilds from these stops; it never scans features.

per_metric_stops.description: Optional metric-id keyed stop lists when metrics carry unequal year sets (Anglican precedent).

kind.description: Ramp kind: sequential, diverging, or categorical. Categorical metrics declare codes with colours visually distinct from every census palette.

stage_id.description: For stages models: the stop this metric belongs to; the metric select repopulates per active stage.

geometry.description: Point or null. Unplaced units (null geometry) stay in the product for the tray and counts; the map never fabricates a position.

end_year.description: Null with a non-null start_year means presence continues through the collection's latest stop; the basis fields carry what that claim rests on.

start_basis.description: site_lifespan_v1 vocabulary. Only founding_stated licenses an absence inference before the start; first_seen_only never manufactures absence.

end_basis.description: Only closure_stated licenses an absence inference after the end; last_seen_only never manufactures absence.

series.description: Metric-id keyed year series: arrays of [year, value] pairs. The slider reads stops from meta, never from these rows.

values.description: Metric-id keyed coded state values with per-value sourcing (Pulotu precedent); used by stages models.

anchors.description: Stage-id keyed calendar anchors for stages models (Pulotu time foci): each unit declares its own dates for the ordinal stops.

tenures.description: People attached to the unit, never units themselves. Names ship only when meta.person_names_public is true; person_ref stays stable either way.

location_basis.description: How the point was placed (e.g. osm_exact, osm_fuzzy, atlas_georeference, sa2_locality, described_locality).

representative_area.description: For low-confidence locality placements: the area the point represents, so the interface can show the actual match basis.

sources.description: Per-unit provenance references in the collection's citation style.

taxonomy_code.description: Optional denomination-taxonomy code: the one cross-layer join key.

pow_site_ref.description: Identity link to an accepted place-of-worship site, once one exists; the runtime dedupe rule keys on this.

SourceDataset.description: Same local relaxation as area-summary.v2: retrieval_date accepts a date or a date-time.
